facts.value: QTEM (Quantitative Techniques for Economics and Management) is a growing international network of leading universities worldwide, supported by international corporate partners. The business partner of the department in the QTEM network is Banco Santander.
The QTEM program includes one or two semesters abroad and an internship.
QTEM Track 1: 1 semester abroad + an internship of 240 hours.
QTEM Track 2: 2 semesters abroad + an internship of 240 hours.

All QTEM students participate in the QTEM Global Business Analytics Challenge (GBAC, 8 ECTS), which consists of a group project on a business case and two preparatory courses focused on soft skills necessary for effective teamwork and case resolution.
A total of 50 ECTS points in quantitative courses must be completed, with 22 ECTS per semester at one of the QTEM partner universities.
The Master’s thesis is written at the home university in Frankfurt.
Upon successful completion of the QTEM program and the Master’s degree from the department, students receive the Master’s degree from the department and a QTEM certificate.
A prerequisite for participating in the QTEM program is proof of a GMAT test score of at least 555 points or an equivalent GRE score.
A new GMAT test format was introduced in the fourth quarter of 2024. The previous format will still be accepted with a minimum score of 600 required.
The application deadline for the academic year 2026/27 ends on February 1, 2026.
New announcements are published at the end of October each year, with the application period ending on February 1 of the following year.
QTEM Partner Universities in Europe: EDHEC Business School, University of Paris Dauphine, LUISS, Politecnico di Milano, DCC Business School, Exeter Business School.
QTEM Partner Universities worldwide: Xiamen University, Zhejiang University, Harbin Institute of Technology, International Business School Suzhou, Xi'an Jiatong-Liverpool University.
